question: Are model predictions, IG atom scores, and calibrated explanation sets stable when the same molecular graph is fully renumbered and attribution is recomputed?
analysis_role: reviewer-driven graph permutation and symmetry audit
cells: 11 tasks x GIN/GCN x seed 42 = 22 historical predictor cells
sample: first 25 test molecules in each pre-existing SHA-256-ordered nonempty-rationale score cache
permutation_draw: 20 unique deterministic nonidentity node permutations per sampled molecule
attribution: true-class signed Integrated Gradients with a zero baseline and 20 steps, recomputed after x, edge_index, and rationale_mask are fully permuted
mapping: Every score and selected set is mapped back to the original atom identities before comparison.

set_policies.index_tiebreak_v1: historical top-ceil fraction with atom index as the tie breaker
set_policies.include_all_exact_ties_v2: include every atom tied at the kth-score boundary
set_policies.rdkit_symmetry_orbit_closure_v3: apply include-all-exact-ties and then include every atom in each selected RDKit graph-symmetry orbit

calibration: Each set policy is independently recalibrated at alpha=0.10 on the original-orientation nonempty-rationale calibration cache for that cell.
same_run_reference: The original-orientation and permuted IG scores are recomputed in the same execution and compared after mapping back. Historical cache scores are retained only as a separate numerical-consistency check and for policy calibration.
tie_measurement: At each policy's own calibrated fraction, report the nominal atom count, exact-tie expansion for original and permuted orientations, and orbit-closure inflation relative to the tie-inclusive set evaluated at that same fraction.
provenance_resume: A cell is reusable only when script, contract, imported partition code, task inputs, upstream cell, score cache, checkpoint, runtime versions, policies, sample size, permutation count, and run mode match; all row files must also have their expected counts.
symmetry_definition: RDKit CanonicalRankAtoms with breakTies=false and includeChirality=true; interpreted only as graph-symmetry classes, not general physicochemical equivalence.
primary_observables: symmetry-orbit split rate and orbit-closure size inflation
existing_selector_check: The separate 378,540-call cached-score selector audit is reused only as selector-level evidence and is not relabeled as re-attribution invariance.
interpretation_boundary: The audit covers graph renumbering, two historical backbones, seed 42, and one attribution implementation. RDKit orbit closure is a sensitivity policy, not a claim that all orbit atoms are mechanistically interchangeable.
negative_result_policy: All prediction flips, low-Jaccard cases, and size inflation are retained.
